title: MxAgile SPA Mockup Bundle Revision
description: Immutable manifest for one accepted revision of a SPA mockup bundle. Located at planning/target-mockups/<mockup-name>/_history/REV-NNN/revision.yaml. Created only when a working-target bundle change is explicitly accepted through the Autonomous Refinement acceptance process, backed by a planning/decisions/DEC-NNN entry. See policies/spa-mockup-bundle.md and policies/mockup-lifecycle.md.

revision_id.description: Stable sequential identifier for this revision, e.g. REV-001. Sequential within a mockup bundle. Must match the containing directory name.

revision.description: Sequential integer index of this revision within the mockup bundle, matching the numeric suffix of revision_id (e.g. REV-003 → revision: 3). Enables direct arithmetic comparison in impact propagation and Design Contract alignment.

previous_revision.description: Integer index of the direct predecessor revision. Null on the first revision (REV-001). Must equal revision - 1 unless a revision was rejected and skipped. Together with revision_id chain forms the complete immutable revision lineage.

lifecycle_status.description: Role of this revision in the active mockup lifecycle. SOURCE: this revision IS the source (initial acceptance, no refinement yet). REFINED_TARGET: this is the currently active acceptance target — exactly one revision per mockup may carry this status. SUPERSEDED_TARGET: a previously active target that has been replaced by a newer REFINED_TARGET revision. When a new revision is accepted as REFINED_TARGET, the prior REFINED_TARGET transitions to SUPERSEDED_TARGET atomically.

refinement_status.description: Acceptance state of this revision proposal. PROPOSED: revision candidate exists but has not yet received developer acceptance. ACCEPTED: developer explicitly accepted this revision (backed by DEC-NNN). REJECTED: revision was explicitly rejected; the prior active target remains active. Only ACCEPTED revisions are stored in _history/. A REJECTED revision must not become active_target.

active_target.description: True if this is the currently active acceptance target for UI implementation and verification. At most ONE revision per mockup bundle may have active_target: true at any time. When this field is true, lifecycle_status must be REFINED_TARGET or SOURCE. Setting active_target: true on a new revision automatically requires setting it to false on the prior active revision (enforced by create_revision.py).

change_scope.description: Human-readable narrative of what changed in this revision. Complements the machine-readable affected_screens and change_classification. Must describe both what changed and why it was accepted. Example: 'Removed login page — authentication via a company authentication platform module, not app-level UI. Role switcher retained as test-only mechanism.'

artifact_path.description: Relative path to the archived HTML artifact for this revision (single-file mockups) or the entry-point within the revision directory (SPA bundles). For SPA bundles this duplicates entry_point but makes the field explicit in cross-revision reports. Null when no standalone HTML artifact exists (e.g. revision was documented via change_scope + delta only).

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the complete HTML artifact file (single-file mockups) or the full bundle hash (SPA bundles, identical to bundle_hash in that case). Null when artifact_path is null. For SPA bundles, prefer bundle_hash as the canonical hash; this field is a convenience alias.

accepted_by.description: Identifier of the person or agent that accepted this revision. For human acceptance: name or role (e.g. 'ProductOwner:Jane'). For agent-proposed acceptance: agent ID (e.g. 'ui-agent'). Null when refinement_status is PROPOSED or REJECTED.

accepted_at.description: ISO date or datetime when this revision was accepted. Null when refinement_status is PROPOSED or REJECTED.

mockup_name.description: Name of the mockup bundle this revision belongs to. Matches the directory under planning/target-mockups/<mockup-name>/.

created_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this revision was accepted and archived.

predecessor_revision_id.description: The previous accepted revision ID. Absent on REV-001 (first revision). Forms an immutable chain of accepted design decisions.

entry_point.description: Relative path to the SPA entry point within this revision directory. Normally 'index.html'. Navigate here to launch the bundle.

bundle_hash.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of the complete bundle contents. Algorithm: for every included file, sort by canonical relative path (forward slashes), compute SHA-256 of raw bytes for each file, build sorted manifest lines '<canonical-path>:<file-sha256>', SHA-256 the resulting joined manifest. Excludes: revision.yaml itself, _history/ subdirectory. See policies/spa-mockup-bundle.md for full algorithm specification.

lifecycle_trigger.description: What lifecycle event created this revision. refinement_accepted: developer accepted a proposed target change. initial_acceptance: first target differs from source mockup. source_rebase_accepted: target was rebased against a new source version with explicit acceptance.

change_classification.description: Whether this change requires re-verification of existing evidence. material: existing parity evidence for affected screens becomes STALE. non_material: cosmetic/non-functional change; agent may PROPOSE this classification but developer must CONFIRM it. unknown: conservative default when classification cannot be determined; treat as material. NEVER use non_material to silently preserve evidence when product authority is changing.

impact_scope.description: Scope of impact for evidence staleness propagation. targeted: only explicitly listed screens/flows are affected; selective staleness via affected_screens. cross_cutting: shared nav/CSS/shell changed; broader staleness scope. full: all screens affected or impact cannot be bounded. unknown: conservative fallback — treat as full. Default is unknown.

affected_screens.description: PAGE-NNN identifiers of screens affected by this revision. Required when impact_scope is 'targeted'. When impact_scope is 'full' or 'cross_cutting', this list is advisory only. Screen identity (PAGE-NNN) is stable across revisions.

affected_flows.description: Optional FLOW-ID labels of navigation flows affected by this revision. Flow IDs correspond to flow_id values on navigation entries in page inventory YAMLs. Advisory only — for diagnostics and reporting.

requirements.description: REQ-NNN identifiers of Requirements whose visual/interaction contract changed in this revision. Populated from affected_screens Requirement relationships. Used for reporting, not for automatic mutation.

acceptance_decisions.description: DEC-NNN identifiers from planning/decisions/ that authorized this revision. Required for lifecycle_trigger=refinement_accepted. The DEC record is the authoritative approval provenance. A schema field alone cannot prove human approval.

reason.description: Human-readable summary of why this revision was accepted.

source_bundle_hash.description: Optional: SHA-256 hash of the source bundle (input-resources/ui-ux/<mockup-name>/) at the time this revision was created. Enables source-target comparison.

revision_delta.description: Machine-readable delta between this revision and its predecessor. Required when revision > 1. Absent on the first revision. Describes what changed, which artifact types were affected, and what downstream action is required. See WP-05.

affected_ids.description: All stable IDs affected by this delta. Must not point to IDs that do not exist or were removed without documentation.

effects.description: Typed list of effects produced by this revision. Each effect describes one observable change and its required downstream action.

type.description: Semantic type of this effect. Used for impact routing.

target.description: ID or path of the affected artifact or element.

required_action.description: What downstream agents must do in response to this effect.

revision_history.description: Append-only ledger of all accepted revisions for this mockup bundle. Each entry records what changed, which IDs were affected, and what evidence is available. Agents must never rewrite existing entries — corrections are added as new entries. See WP-03.

status.description: Status of this revision at the time the ledger was written. ACTIVE_TARGET at write time; SUPERSEDED once a newer revision is accepted.

artifact_available.description: True if a full HTML or bundle snapshot exists for this revision.

preservation.description: Evidence-based preservation verification result for this revision. Replaces a simple binary pass. See WP-04.

status.description: VERIFIED: full baseline available, no unexpected losses. VERIFIED_WITH_LEDGER: ledger covers revision path, no unexplained losses. PARTIAL_EVIDENCE: some history unavailable; cannot fully prove preservation. FAILED: unexpected loss detected — do not accept this revision.
